Then by and by as we walkd, he askd mine Vncle, gin hee would giue him me to make a Lady till him. And by my trouth Mistris Trainwell, I lee not, I blush'd and luk'd vpon him as I would feine a hed it so: Mine Vncle said yes, and sir Phillip shuke my haund, and gude feath my heart ioyd at it. God gin the Priest had beene by. But I thought all sure enough; and would not ha' sold my part for the Spanish Ladies Ioincture. But streight anon mine Vncle and he fell on other talke, of Lords and La dies, and many foud like things, I minded not: For I is weell sure, this keept me waking ere sine.
